rationale: This randomized parallel trial includes an explicit sham comparator arm. The record states participants receive either TPS treatment or sham TPS treatment, and the sham uses the same device and protocol but blocks the sound waves so the motor cortex is not stimulated.

title: Testing Pulse Stimulation to Improve Motor Function in People With ALS: A Pilot Study
